scope: Exploratory, conditional counting-model block profiles; not causal or population inference.

protocol.resampling: Joint full-bitstring multinomial; independent pub draws; four observed rounds fixed
protocol.intervals: Pointwise percentile 95%; simultaneous 95% standardized-max bands for 30 contrasts
protocol.family: Six blocks in five observed contexts
protocol.marginal_share: Ratio of round-mean product reduction to round-mean energy reduction
